mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during supply chain disruption regimes.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 95.0 periods, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) versus overall average.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 2.0% quarterly indicates expanding economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate market repricing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where CPIAUCSL > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase and employment decline (PAYEMS) signals labor market collapse that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.05) over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 during manufacturing slowdown regimes indicates sector weakness that reduces corporate investment and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where INDPRO < 95.0.
